🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Autonomous AI agents often need to perform recurring duties: generating daily morning digests, triag"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ing bug trackers, checking API health, syncing databases, or running periodic Git hygiene. Without a"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" dedicated scheduler inside the harness, users must rely on external crontab wrappers, complex webho"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ok setups, or manual intervention."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-cron`** is a native full-stack scheduling and background automation plugin for "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"DeepSeek Harness. It bridges standard cron expressions and natural interval syntax with autonomous a"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"gent execution, providing:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **Rich Visual Task Manager** — a sidebar button with a collapsible list of active jobs (next run "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"or live state, capped and persisted), plus a full panel to inspect, filter by type/model/channel, pa"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"use, trigger, duplicate, export/import and create tasks.
2. **Interactive "Create with DSH" Workflow"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"** — chat with your agent to translate high-level requirements into a well-formed scheduled task.
3."},{"id":"p10s5","text":" **Autonomous AI Tool Calling** — single unified `cron` tool (`action: 'create' | 'list' | 'get' | '"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"update' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'run' | 'delete'`) lets agents inspect, trigger, and manage backgroun"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"d automation without schema bloat.
4. **Robust Scheduler & Atomic Storage** — built on `croner` with"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" interval aliases, one-shot delays, atomic file persistence, run histories, and cost tracking.
5. **"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"Six Execution Runtimes** — shell, Node.js, Python, HTTP/webhook, remote SSH and Docker, plus per-tas"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"k environment variables, workspace binding and isolated git worktrees for code-modifying agent tasks"},{"id":"p10s11","text":".
6. **Multi-Channel Delivery With Templates** — one run fans out to Telegram, dsh-kanban, Discord, "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"Slack, ntfy, Bark, PushPlus, voice (`dsh-tts`) and Gitea, with `{variable}` message templates and se"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"crets referenced by DSH credential name."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 🏗️ Architecture"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## ✨ Features & Capabilities"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 🐝 Swarm Delegation & Parallel Multi-Agent Execution (#350)
- **Controlled Worker Pool**: Configu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"re `concurrencyLimit` (1..10, default 3) to execute independent subtasks in parallel without overloa"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ding system resources.
- **Fault-Tolerant Decomposition**: Subtask failures are isolated; the swarm "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"aggregates all successful results and flags partial errors gracefully.
- **Automated Synthesis**: Ag"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"gregates worker outputs into a structured Markdown digest or delegates synthesis to a designated syn"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"thesizer model.
- **Swarm Metrics & History**: Run history records total, succeeded, failed counts, "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"and duration alongside detailed per-worker execution logs."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 🔍 Git Diff & Interactive Patch Review (#351, #379)
- **Scoped Diff Capture**: Tasks running in G"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"it worktrees capture modified files, stat summary, and unified diffs (up to 256 KiB) automatically. "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"Non-worktree tasks ignore repository diffs by default, avoiding storage bloat, but can opt in explic"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"itly via `captureGitDiff: true`.
- **Lightweight Archive Storage**: Historical run archives automati"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"cally strip heavy raw diff payloads into concise excerpts with byte-budget caps (max 15MB) and autom"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"atic cleanup of orphaned `.tmp.*` files.
- **1-Click Discard**: Revert uncommitted working directory"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" changes safely with a single click (`git reset --hard HEAD && git clean -fd`).
- **1-Click Apply**:"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" Re-apply previously captured diffs directly to the repository (`git apply --whitespace=fix`).
- **I"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"nteractive Run Preview**: Color-coded diff inspector embedded directly into the execution history dr"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ctive Run Preview**: Color-coded diff inspector embedded directly into the execution history drawer."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 🔀 Decision Nodes & Conditional IF/ELSE Branching (#352)
- **Conditional Routing**: Tasks can def"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ine `branchRules` evaluating execution outcomes (`exitCode`, `output`, `output.json.<path>`, `status"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"`) with operators (`equals`, `notequals`, `contains`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `regex`, `exists`).
"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"- **Fallback Else**: Optional `elseTask` triggers when no branch condition matches.
- **Deadlock-Fre"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"e Synchronization**: Untriggered branch tasks are safely recorded with `status: 'skipped'`, unblocki"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ng downstream join barriers (`joinPolicy: 'all_success'`).
- **Graph Visualization**: DAG Graph View"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" displays decision badges (`🔀 Decision`) and condition labels on connecting edges."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 🩺 Autonomous Self-Healing Doctor (#353)
- **Failure Classification**: Automatic detection of 8 f"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ailure categories: `syntax_error`, `dependency_missing`, `rate_limit`, `auth_failed`, `schema_change"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"`, `timeout`, `network_error`, `runtime_error`.
- **Unified Diff**: Clean line-by-line diff preview "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"of proposed fixes before application.
- **1-Click Apply & Revert**: Dedicated `/doctor/apply` and `/"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"doctor/revert` endpoints with full revision backup (up to 10 versions preserved in `task.revisions`)"},{"id":"p17s6","text":".
- **Guarded Autonomous Auto-Healing**: When `autoHeal: true`, high-confidence fixes are applied au"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"tomatically with a strict 24-hour rate limit to prevent repair loops."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 1. Visual Task Manager & Sidebar Action
Click the clock icon in the DSH sidebar (positioned next"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" to the new-session button) to open the management panel:
* **Status Filter Tabs**: toggle between *"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"*All**, **Active**, **Paused**, and **Completed** tasks.
* **Instant Action Menu**: trigger manual o"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ne-off executions (**Run Now**), pause/resume schedules, or delete obsolete tasks with a confirmatio"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"n step.
* **1-Click Preset Templates**: scaffold common workflows like *Daily digest*, *Weekly revie"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"w*, and *Follow-up monitor*.
* **Execution History**: open any task card to review previous runs — t"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"imestamps, durations, statuses (success / failed / timeout / skipped / missed), outputs, and errors."},{"id":"p18s8","text":"
* **Aggregated Stats Bar**: live dashboard with active task count, total runs, total token consumpt"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ion, and the estimated dollar spend.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Security & Safe Execution
- **Hardened Path Validation**: Wake trigger markers and file watchers"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" strictly disallow access to system directories (`/etc`, `/proc`, `/sys`, `C:\Windows`).
- **SSRF Gu"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ard**: Automated blocking of cloud metadata endpoints (`169.254.169.254`)."}],"truncated":true}
